title: Finite matching equations become effective at a stage
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : Iᵒᵖ → Scheme a system of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps, c its limit cone, i₀ a stage, and G a sheaf of sets on D(i₀). Let W be a qcqs étale object, V : Fin n → D(i₀).Etale a finite family of qcqs étale objects, and f_b : V_b → W arrows. Fix a stage j in Over(i₀ᵒᵖ) and stage sections s_b on the base changes of V_b. Write r_d for the transition comparison and q_j for the limit comparison of [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison]. Suppose that for every étale Z over D(i₀), every b,b', and p : Z → V_b, p' : Z → V_b' satisfying p f_b = p' f_b', the limit images q_j(Z)(p_j^*s_b) and q_j(Z)(p'_j^*s_b') agree. There exist a later stage l and an arrow d : l → j such that for every étale Y over D(l), and every a : Y → V_{b,l}, a' : Y → V_{b',l} with a f_{b,l} = a' f_{b',l}, one has a^*(r_d(V_b)s_b) = a'^*(r_d(V_b')s_b'). No affine hypothesis on V, covering hypothesis, affine lifting property, or global limit section is assumed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Étale Cohomology, Tags 03Q4 and 09YQ

proof.text: For each ordered pair in Fin n × Fin n apply the fixed-pair eventual-matching theorem, with the two qcqs instance hypotheses and the matching assumption specialized to that pair.

Choose a common predecessor of j and the finitely many pair witness stages using IsCofiltered.inf_objs_exists. Thinness of Over of the indexing preorder identifies each composite arrow to j with the chosen arrow d. Apply the persistence part of the fixed-pair theorem at this common stage and rewrite the arrow equality. When n=0 the finite set of pair witness stages is empty and the same construction works without any pair equation.
